coreClaim: A Roleplay scene created by the user-invoked /scene command activates Narrative Craft and sends its opening through the normal Roleplay generation pipeline instead of displaying the scene planner's draft as finished prose.

inScope: Narrative Craft activation on newly created scene chats
Configured Roleplay writer ownership of the opening
Honest partial-success handling when opening generation cannot start
outOfScope: Changing the configured writer or Agent model
Guaranteeing that every individual output passes a detector

claimBoundary.coreClaim: The /scene planner supplies scene intent and metadata, while the existing Roleplay pipeline and configured writer produce the visible opening with Narrative Craft active.
claimBoundary.riskType: prompt ownership, model-call ordering, and cross-entrypoint compatibility
entrypoints: Normal Roleplay generation for the newly created chat
legacyPathsOrFormats: Callers that omit openingMode still persist the planner's opening
Existing scene lifecycle metadata and conversation carryover remain unchanged
outOfScopeClaims: No claim that StoryScope is a production quality score.
No claim that /scene creation has zero added latency.
No claim that non-/scene scene-opening callers use the configured writer.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: The /scene route created a Roleplay chat without Narrative Craft and persisted planner-authored prose directly, bypassing the configured Roleplay writer and corrections.
contractLaneGate.producer: src/engine/modes/roleplay/scene creates scene chat state; src/shared/lib/slash-commands invokes the user-facing /scene workflow.
contractLaneGate.consumer: The Roleplay generation runtime and the user-visible opening message.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A user-created Roleplay scene should have the same default craft agent and writer pipeline as a normal Roleplay chat.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: Scene creation records the default Roleplay background agents; /scene requests a deferred opening and invokes generation against the new scene chat with the planner draft as intent only.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: The scene service owns persisted scene state; the slash command owns handing the new chat to the existing generation pipeline.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not rewrite planner prose in React, add a second visible writer, or make Conversation and Game inherit Roleplay orchestration.
regressionProof: The scene-service test fails before the fix because activeAgentIds and enableAgents are absent.
The slash-command test fails before the fix because openingMode is not deferred and ctx.generate is never called.
The final focused suite proves activation, writer routing, legacy planned-opening behavior, and partial-failure handling.

positiveRows.evidence: The scene-service regression asserts activeAgentIds contains narrative-craft and enableAgents is true.

positiveRows.claim: The configured Roleplay writer owns the /scene opening.
positiveRows.evidence: The slash-command regression asserts the planner draft is deferred and ctx.generate targets the new scene chat with a narrator guide.

contradictionRows.claim: An opening failure must not be reported as a scene-creation failure.
contradictionRows.evidence: False and rejected generation tests preserve navigation to the created scene and return explicit partial-success feedback.

contradictionRows.claim: The planner draft must not become the second visible writer.
contradictionRows.evidence: The guide labels firstMessage as intent rather than prose to copy; only the normal Roleplay generation result is persisted for /scene.

legacyDefaultRows.claim: Existing non-/scene callers retain their planned opening behavior.
legacyDefaultRows.evidence: openingMode is optional and the complete pre-existing scene-service suite remains green.

untestedRows: A post-deploy live /scene generation on the Pi is completed after matching images are published.

ownedFacts.description: The affected live scene had no active agent IDs, no Agent runs, and no roleplay quality correction metadata.
ownedFacts.evidence: Read-only inspection of the reported Pi chat before the fix.

ownedFacts.description: The production JavaScript bundle remains within its enforced budget.
ownedFacts.evidence: pnpm perf:size measured 1724.8 KiB gzip against the 1726.0 KiB total-JS limit.

negativeRowsTested: Non-generated opening mode retains the existing planned message
